pages.text: The Moving Earth family raises a column of existing terrain one layer at a time. Its three source workings use small, medium, or large Ritual circles to choose the footprint; they do not carve the wandering rift worked by Broken Earth.

Offer $(item)Brew of Sprouting$() and $(item)Cactus$(). Add $(item)Gunpowder$() on a small circle, $(item)Redstone$() on a medium circle, or $(item)Glowstone Dust$() on a large circle. Each accepted working raises one terrain layer every five ticks.

pages.title: Three Scales
pages.text: The small working alone accepts an optional Bound Waystone to move its effect. All three preserve the terrain they lift rather than stamping a replacement material into the air. Break or re-click the sustaining circle to stop and refund the consumed offerings.
